questions.question: 1. What does an antenna's 'beam pattern' illustrate?

answers.a: The antenna's physical size and weight
answers.b: The strength and direction of radio waves it transmits or receives
answers.c: The amount of power the antenna consumes
answers.d: The type of data the antenna can process

questions.question: 2. The '3dB beamwidth' is the angular width where the antenna's radiated power drops to what level?

answers.a: One-quarter of the maximum power
answers.b: Zero power
answers.c: One-half of the maximum power
answers.d: Three-quarters of the maximum power

questions.question: 3. What is the 'horizontal beam pattern' of a base station antenna used to study?

answers.a: The signal strength directly above the antenna
answers.b: The signal coverage pattern on the ground, in a 360-degree plane
answers.c: The signal's ability to penetrate buildings
answers.d: The antenna's signal strength at different elevations

questions.question: 4. The 'vertical beam pattern' is concerned with the signal's strength at different...?

answers.a: Frequencies
answers.b: Distances from the tower
answers.c: Compass directions (north, south, east, west)
answers.d: Elevation angles (up and down)

questions.question: 5. A narrower 3dB beamwidth in the horizontal plane generally implies what?

answers.a: The antenna covers a wider area all around it
answers.b: The antenna's signal is weaker
answers.c: The antenna's signal is more focused in a specific direction
answers.d: The antenna can only be used indoors

questions.question: 6. What is the primary purpose of studying the vertical beam pattern?

answers.a: To determine the maximum range of the antenna on a flat plane
answers.b: To ensure the signal is aimed correctly towards the ground where users are
answers.c: To measure the antenna's total power output
answers.d: To check for interference from satellite signals

questions.question: 7. The 'tilt angle' in a vertical beam pattern refers to...?

answers.a: The physical angle the antenna is mounted at
answers.b: The angle at which the main lobe of the signal is directed up or down
answers.c: The angle of the antenna relative to the north pole
answers.d: The width of the main signal beam

questions.question: 8. Why is finding the 3dB beamwidth important for a base station?

answers.a: It determines the antenna's manufacturing cost
answers.b: It helps define the specific coverage area the antenna will serve
answers.c: It indicates the antenna's color
answers.d: It measures the antenna's data speed

questions.question: 9. A base station antenna's main lobe is...

answers.a: The direction of weakest signal
answers.b: The part of the antenna that physically moves
answers.c: The direction of maximum signal strength and coverage
answers.d: A secondary, undesired signal

questions.question: 10. Calculating the horizontal and vertical beamwidths helps network planners do what?

answers.a: Choose the correct paint color for the antenna tower
answers.b: Control interference and optimize coverage for users
answers.c: Determine the antenna's power consumption
answers.d: Calculate the antenna's total weight

questions.question: 11. What is a 'sidelobe' in an antenna's beam pattern?

answers.a: The main, intended direction of the signal
answers.b: A smaller beam of radiation in an undesired direction
answers.c: The physical mounting bracket for the antenna
answers.d: The part of the antenna that receives power

questions.question: 12. Adjusting the 'tilt angle' of the vertical pattern primarily helps to...?

answers.a: Change the signal's frequency
answers.b: Increase the antenna's total power
answers.c: Control how far the signal reaches and reduce interference with distant cells
answers.d: Make the antenna point towards the east or west

questions.question: 13. The objective of studying the horizontal beam pattern relates to which plane of coverage?

answers.a: The vertical (up and down) plane
answers.b: The azimuthal (left and right) plane
answers.c: The diagonal plane
answers.d: The internal circuitry plane

questions.question: 14. A 'beam pattern' is a graphical representation of what antenna property?

answers.a: Its temperature
answers.b: Its radiation intensity in different directions
answers.c: Its electrical resistance
answers.d: Its age

questions.question: 15. Why would an engineer want to know the 3dB beamwidth specifically?

answers.a: It defines the most effective and useful part of the signal beam
answers.b: It is the only part of the signal that carries data
answers.c: It tells the antenna's maximum possible range
answers.d: It determines the physical length of the antenna

questions.question: 16. If a base station antenna has a very narrow vertical beamwidth, it means...

answers.a: The signal is spread out widely in the vertical direction
answers.b: The signal is highly concentrated at a specific elevation angle
answers.c: The antenna provides weak signal coverage
answers.d: The antenna covers a full 360-degree circle

questions.question: 17. The 'main lobe' is found in which beam patterns?

answers.a: Only the horizontal pattern
answers.b: Only the vertical pattern
answers.c: Neither the horizontal nor the vertical pattern
answers.d: Both the horizontal and vertical patterns

questions.question: 18. What is the 'tilt angle' of a base station antenna primarily used to manage?

answers.a: The signal's frequency band
answers.b: The cell's coverage area and potential interference
answers.c: The antenna's power source
answers.d: The direction of the horizontal coverage

questions.question: 19. An antenna's beam pattern is also known as its...

answers.a: Radiation pattern
answers.b: Frequency response
answers.c: Power curve
answers.d: Impedance chart

questions.question: 20. The '3dB' in '3dB beamwidth' is a reference to what?

answers.a: The signal power being reduced by half
answers.b: The antenna having three distinct beams
answers.c: The signal traveling for three kilometers
answers.d: The antenna operating at three gigahertz
